Title: Rose Wood Knit Vest
Body (HTML): This AMESH Artisanal hand-knitted top is crafted by skilled Sri Lankan home knitter Ranjini using deadstock Norwegian Børstet Alpakka wool blended with silk mohair. This distinctive yarn combines natural fibres with a durable nylon core, creating a brushed, airy texture that is both lightweight and luxuriously soft. Naturally hollow and breathable, the fibre adapts effortlessly to shifting temperatures, offering warmth in cooler climates while remaining comfortable in the heat. Inspired by the island’s pristine skylines, the vest features a delicate interplay of ivory, cobalt blue, and rosewood tones. Thoughtfully designed for versatility, it is finished with a classic V-neckline, ribbed armholes, and a structured waistband that grounds its relaxed silhouette. A one-of-a-kind piece, ideal for layering across seasons.
